description:
Adds the Concordact, a powerful minor polity with a presence in the northwestern Core Worlds, past League space, along with their unique ship modifications.

The Ships

Requires MagicLib, LazyLib, GraphicsLib and Nexerelin.

(Not compatible with existing saves! A new save will be required to experience this mod.)

Download: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1bebjnAmR6ycxd-PGeamWAtEFscd6Qc8K/view?usp=sharing

Changelog
0.2.0 (don't ask about 0.1.0)
Initial mod release

Concordact Navy - Emergent Threats

A submod for Rise of the Concordact Navy, adding a selection of Concordact modifications of IX Battlegroup ships. Requires Emergent Threats and IX Revival.

Download: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1an6CmAwLCrFrXyWNWQv9T5GaUwMRDDuf/view?usp=sharing

The Ships

(Credits to Fellout, BinBin and Joebob for letting me use their ships, Tariflette for the Nightjar and (spoiler) sprites, and Vicegrip for letting me use ET and IX assets.)

(No AI has been used in any area of this project! If there is AI content anywhere, I didn't put it there, and please let me know so I can get rid of it.)

Okay, first forum post...really hoping I did this right...
